definitions.explanation: An answer that is not correct. The formal opposite of {正解|せいかい} (correct answer). Used in tests, quizzes, and game shows.

examples.japanese: {不正解|ふせいかい}！⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧。
{不正解|ふせいかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦クイズ→クイズ：10804_kuizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不正解|ふせいかい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させられる→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the quiz show, if you get a wrong answer, you have to do a punishment game.

notes:
{不正解|ふせいかい} is the formal opposite of ⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧ (correct answer). It is used to explicitly declare an answer wrong.

FORMS:
{不|ふ} (non-, un-) + ⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧ (correct answer).

USAGE:
- TV quiz shows: {不正解|ふせいかい}！ (Wrong!)
- Educational apps and tests
- Formal testing environments
In everyday conversation, people more commonly say ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ or ⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ rather than {不正解|ふせいかい}. The word {不正解|ふせいかい} has a declarative, official tone — like a buzzer going off.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧: mistake (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{誤答|ごとう}→誤答：17434_gotou⟧: wrong answer (formal, academic testing)
- ⟦{誤|あやま}り→誤り：01772_ayamari⟧: error (general)
